decisions.reason: A schlager compilation fits the label's core catalog, and with industry turnover growing and a large warehouse as slack, holding stock costs little even if sales are modest.
The illustrated series is a multi-model line that builds the firm's curation profile and supports its push to broaden, so it meets aspirations and gives no trigger for search.
Reissued jazz vinyl matches the firm's genre expansion and the strong vinyl demand, though a limited pressing could sell out and leave the catalog.
Premium box sets are a hallmark of the established offer and earn good margins with collectors, but limited editions may go out of print.
This generic compilation was only mentioned, not given its own page, so its visibility is lower, but in a growing market with ample warehouse slack there is little pressure to drop it.
